title: Free or Guarded?
setup: Your knight on e4 can capture two different black pieces — but only one of them is actually free.
hint: Before you grab, ask: who takes back? Check the defenders of d6 and f6.
explanation:
## The Idea

Two captures beckon:

- {{Nxd6}} snatches a pawn, but the pawn on c7 **defends d6** and takes back at once. You would trade a three-point knight for a one-point pawn.
- {{Nxf6}} snatches the bishop, and **nothing defends f6**. Three clean points.

The right question is never "what can I capture?" but "what can I capture for free?" Count the defenders before every capture.
